description: Synthetic, hand-authored underwriting scenarios; not expert-validated or representative of production accuracy.

criteria.text: Flag a concern when annual fire-safety training completion is below 90% of employees.

evidence.quote: The applicant reported annual revenue of $8 million and 42 employees.

expected.rationale: Revenue and headcount do not establish training completion. Absence of relevant evidence does not establish no_match.

criteria.text: Record a strength when all forklift operators completed certified forklift safety training during 2025.

evidence.quote: During 2025, all office accountants completed cybersecurity training. No forklift-operator training records were provided.

expected.rationale: The training population and subject differ. Accountants completing cybersecurity training says nothing about forklift training.

criteria.text: Flag a concern if the warehouse sprinkler system was inoperable on 2025-06-30.

evidence.quote: Warehouse A sprinkler system: inoperable on 2025-06-30.
evidence.context: Independent qualified inspection. Same inspection time and authority as inspection B; no precedence or correction is documented.

evidence.quote: Warehouse A sprinkler system: fully operational on 2025-06-30.
evidence.context: Independent qualified inspection. Same inspection time and authority as inspection A; no precedence or correction is documented.

expected.rationale: Equally authoritative contemporaneous reports conflict. Both must be cited and the conflict cannot be resolved from these inputs.

criteria.text: Flag a concern if the warehouse sprinkler system was inoperable on 2025-06-30.

evidence.quote: Report R1: Warehouse A sprinkler system was inoperable on 2025-06-30.

Signed correction to R1 by its original inspector, issued 2025-07-01: the inoperable entry was a transcription error. The sprinkler system was fully operational on 2025-06-30. This correction supersedes R1.

expected.rationale: The explicit correction resolves the conflict for the same date. This is not missing evidence or an exclusion from scope.

criteria.text: For an occupied building, flag a concern for a roof older than 20 years, except when a licensed engineer certified at least 10 years of remaining useful life within the past 12 months. Assess as of 2025-07-01.

evidence.quote: Building A is occupied and its roof is 25 years old as of 2025-07-01.
On 2025-03-01 a licensed engineer certified Building A's roof had 12 years of remaining useful life.

expected.rationale: The rule applies to this occupied building but its explicit exception defeats the concern. Certification is four months old and exceeds the 10-year threshold.

criteria.text: This rule applies only to commercial kitchens with deep-fat fryers. Flag a concern when the hood suppression system has not been serviced in the past six months.

evidence.quote: This premises operates exclusively as a cold-food sandwich shop. It has no deep-fat fryers and no hot-cooking equipment.

expected.rationale: The explicit fryer scope excludes this premises. No service history is needed to establish the exclusion.

criteria.text: Flag a separate concern for each occupied building whose roof is more than 20 years old.

evidence.quote: Building A is occupied and has a 24-year-old roof.
Building B is occupied and has a 31-year-old roof.
Building C is occupied and has a 5-year-old roof.

expected.rationale: A and B each warrant a separate concern; C does not. A single combined finding fails the requested output granularity even if it cites both roofs.

criteria.text: Record a separate strength for each warehouse with monitored automatic sprinklers covering 100% of its floor area.

evidence.quote: North warehouse has monitored automatic sprinklers covering 100% of its floor area.
South warehouse has monitored automatic sprinklers covering 100% of its floor area.

expected.rationale: Each warehouse qualifies independently, requiring two strength records under C1. Cross-source consolidation must preserve the separate findings.
